description: An object of the PathName type specifies a certain path on a host.
It is used for specifying stdin/stdout/stderr paths via submit options -i/-o/-e/-j.
For different hosts different paths can be specified in the form [host:]path[,[host:]path...].
There is some simple file staging facility, to be evaluated.

attributes.name: path
description: Path to a file or directory.

attributes.name: host
description: Name of the host where this specification is valid.
If it is left empty (nullptr), then the path is valid on all hosts (default).

attributes.name: file_host
description: @todo for file staging, the host where the file is available?

attributes.name: file_staging
description: Do file staging when set to true. @todo status of filestaging?
